policies.version_freeze: one request freezes model_id, provider and price.version; switching requires a later explicit turn
policies.retry: only known pre-send or explicit 429/5xx rejection may retry once; unknown or missing usage is never re-sent or switched
policies.usage_missing: usage.known=false; runtime mark_unknown keeps the reservation and does not settle 0
policies.context_guard: estimate_tokens(messages+tools)+1024+max_output_tokens must fit context_tokens before any request
policies.cache: only known successful responses are cached; cache hits settle zero cost and are marked cached=true
policies.tool_arguments: tool argument JSON is assembled from deltas; invalid or interrupted arguments become finish_reason=error or UnknownModelOutcome
policies.cancellation: checked before the request and between SSE chunks; no partial response is accepted
